investigation.title: Remote Agents: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocking All Agent Provisioning Evals (production-api)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-09-16T12:36–12:37Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production-api's POST /api/agents endpoint could not reach the swarm ELB target at /v1/agents. Because the failure is uniform across every check in the feature and no evidence was collected at all, the swarm gateway — not any individual eval or runner branch — is the earliest violated boundary.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway (an AWS ELB in us-east-2 fronting /v1/agents) was unreachable from the production-api at the time of the eval run. Every call to POST /api/agents that requires remote agent provisioning received HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" and the message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning". Because the failure occurred before any agent was created, no evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was ever written, causing all four required contract fields to be missing. This is an eval-observed infrastructure connectivity failure localized to the swarm gateway dependency of the remote-agents feature; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.

possibleCauses: [Most likely] The swarm ELB target (us-east-2) was down, misconfigured, or had no healthy registered targets at the time of the eval run, causing the production-api to receive a 502 on every outbound request to /v1/agents.

[Possible] The swarm service itself (the process behind the ELB) crashed or was restarting, leaving the ELB with no healthy backends to forward requests to.

investigations.summary: All three remote-agents checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-09-16T12:36–12:37Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production-api's POST /api/agents endpoint could not reach the swarm ELB target at /v1/agents. investigations.rootCause: The swarm gateway (an AWS ELB in us-east-2 fronting /v1/agents) was unreachable from the production-api at the time of the eval run. Every call to POST /api/agents that requires remote agent provisioning received HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" and the message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning". Because the failure occurred before any agent was created, no evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was ever written, causing all four required contract fields to be missing. investigations.rootCause: The snapshot published at https://cypher-asi.github.io/aura-os/observability/status.json has not been regenerated and republished within the required 300-minute window. The snapshot was sourced from desktop-nightly-release rather than github-actions, indicating the automated GitHub Actions workflow that is expected to keep the snapshot fresh either did not run, failed silently, or was not scheduled within the past ~11 hours.
